relativePayouts.basis: Ratios of rounded displayed values. Matching suffixes cancel across teams; no suffix exponent sizes are assumed.

relativeTierFactors.basis: Compare within-team Super/Boss and Ultra/Super ratios between teams; both the numerator and denominator suffix scales cancel. These observations do not identify the underlying source bonuses.

findings: B shows about 45.48 times A Boss Gold and 4.676 times A Super Gold, while A shows about 2.953 times B Ultra Gold.

The displayed Super/Boss factor is about 9.727 times larger for A, and its Ultra/Super factor is about 13.809 times larger. A strong Boss Gold result alone therefore does not establish the best Ultra Gold payout.

The inspected Rogue and Hunter gold synergy values match existing bases after applying the event and capture-specific owner modifiers; the seven newly proposed Hunter-related field/base corrections concern cooldown, skill, damage or energy effects, not gold effects.
